content:
A **Jackalope** or **Jackelope** [1] 
is a mentioned-only cryptid.

The Word List for Daniel Bird mentions making the Jackalope the "new national mascot," followed by the question "is this an American creature?" [2] Mole Rats may be named "Jackelope" if the Chosen One chooses to participate in Molerat Mambo in Redding. [1] 

A Jackalope Plushie and Jackalope Gun Rack are C.A.M.P. objects that can be obtained in *Fallout 76*. The creature is also seen on the sign for Priblos' Curios and mentioned in the Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt radio play. A taxidermy bust of the Jackalope was added as C.A.M.P. wall decor items, including the Mounted Jackalope Head and Mounted Winter Jackalope Head. There are also two Fasnacht masks, the Fasnacht Jackalope Mask and Fasnacht Glowing Jackalope Mask.
